The prompt's decision ladder skips games won by a lead taken for good in Q3, and it is vague about runs that 'held', 反超, overtime and bare-seconds clocks, and quarter scores that aren't in the facts; a cheap model will guess on these more often than these three samples suggest.","findings":[{"severity":"high","what":"The ladder never covers a lead for good taken in Q3, and case (3) 'opened the gap that held' does not say what 'held' means. In Example 0, a literal reader falls through to case (3) and names the 14-0 Q1 run. That run started from a 5-point lead, and the game changed hands again after it, so it did not decide anything.","evidence":"Prompt: \"(2) a lead for good taken in Q4 or OT … (4) if the winner was ahead for good from Q1 or Q2\". Example 0 facts: \"ahead for good: Q3 4:14\" and \"Biggest run: {t:10} 14-0, Q1 2.6 to Q2 8:08 (from 29-24 for them)\" with \"Lead changes: 3\". Haiku happened to pick the Q3 lead, but nothing in the rules sent it there.","fix":"Make case (2) cover Q3, Q4 and OT. Define a run that 'held' as one that ended at or after the ahead-for-good moment."},{"severity":"medium","what":"Two lines work against each other. The prompt says only 'came back from N down' shows the winner trailed, yet the facts also say 'trailed by N going into Qn'. The adjective rule never says when 反超 is allowed. In Example 1 the model avoided the natural 反超 and wrote a wrong-sense verb instead.","evidence":"Prompt: \"Only \\\"came back from N down\\\" says the winner trailed.\" Example 1 facts: \"{t:6} trailed by 3 going into the Q4\". Answer: \"由{p:6442}一記三分推進，以98-97領先至終場\". 推進 means 'advance', not 'go ahead'; a Taiwan desk would write 投進三分反超.","fix":"Count the 'trailed by N going into' line as trailing. Give an explicit rule for each word: 逆轉 / 反超 / 打破平手 / 拉開. Ask for plain shot verbs."},{"severity":"medium","what":"There is no written format for overtime or for bare-seconds clocks. A cheap model may invent 第五節 or Q5, or turn 2.6 into 2:06 or 2分6秒, and the digit-only check might not catch that.","evidence":"Prompt only shows 「第三節剩4:14」 and \"with 4:14 left in the third\", yet it says \"a bare 2.6 = 2.6 seconds left\". Example 1's facts contain 38.6, 20.6 and 18.0.","fix":"Add the zh and en forms for OT, 2OT and bare seconds. Require numbers in digits, never 十三-style numerals, which numbersFrom() can't check."},{"severity":"medium","what":"Case (4) asks for 'the period they won big' even when the facts give no quarter score. That invites an invented quarter score or a misused run.","evidence":"Prompt: \"(4) … that they led from then on, plus the period they won big.\" Example 2 had \"won the Q3 40-22\", but not every digest will.","fix":"Use the period only when a 'won the Qn' line gives it; otherwise just say they led from then on."},{"severity":"low","what":"clean() never checks that zh and en name the same teams and players, or that zh is one sentence, not a ；-joined list. Both are things the prompt demands and code can check.","evidence":"clean(): \"if (!zh || !en || toks.some(t => !facts.includes(t))) return null;\" checks only that each token exists in the facts. Prompt: \"never a list of facts joined by ；\".","fix":"Reject when the zh and en token sets differ or when zh contains ；/;."}],"edits":[{"old":"(2) a lead for good taken in Q4 or OT: when and on whose play; (3) a run by the winner that took them from behind or level to ahead, or opened the gap that held;","new":"(2) a lead for good taken in Q3, Q4 or OT: when and on whose play; (3) a run by the winner that took them from behind or level to ahead, or that ended at or after their \"ahead for good\" time and opened the gap that held (a run that ended before the lead for good was taken did NOT hold);","why":"Closes the Q3 gap seen in Example 0 and defines 'held', so the early 14-0 run can't be picked."},{"old":"(4) if the winner was ahead for good from Q1 or Q2: that they led from then on, plus the period they won big.","new":"(4) if the winner was ahead for good from Q1 or Q2: that they led from then on, plus the period they won big only if a \"won the Qn\" line gives it (else just that they led from then on).","why":"Stops invented quarter scores when the digest has no 'won the Qn' line."},{"old":"Only \"came back from N down\" says the winner trailed.","new":"Only \"came back from N down\" or \"trailed by N going into\" says the winner trailed.","why":"The facts use both lines; the old wording contradicts Example 1's digest."},{"old":"No adjectives the facts don’t support: 反超, 逆轉, 改寫, “erased a deficit” or “broke it open” only when the facts show it.","new":"No words the facts don’t support: 逆轉 / “erased a deficit” only with a \"came back from N down\" line; 反超 / “went ahead” when the winner trailed before the ahead-for-good play (came back, or trailed going into a period); if the score before it was level, 打破平手; 拉開 / “broke it open” only for a winner’s run that held; 改寫 never. For the play, use plain shot words (投進三分、切入上籃、罰球命中), never vague verbs like 推進.","why":"Gives the cheap model a checkable rule per word and fixes the wrong-sense 推進 in Example 1."},{"old":"Write clock times as 「第三節剩4:14」 and scores as 「62-60」, digits exactly as the facts give them. en: the same sentence in English, ≤ 22 words, times as \"with 4:14 left in the third\".","new":"Write clock times as 「第三節剩4:14」, OT as 「延長賽剩1:12」 (2OT 「第二個延長賽剩1:12」), a bare 2.6 as 「第四節剩2.6秒」, and scores as 「62-60」; every number in digits exactly as the facts give them, never 十三-style numerals. en: the same sentence in English, ≤ 22 words, times as \"with 4:14 left in the third\", \"with 1:12 left in overtime\", \"with 2.6 seconds left in the fourth\".","why":"Overtime and bare-seconds clocks had no written form; Chinese numerals would slip past numbersFrom()."},{"old":"if (!zh || !en || toks.some(t => !facts.includes(t))) return null;","new":"const tokSet = s => [...new Set(s.match(/\\{[pt]:[^}]+\\}/g) || [])].sort().join(',');\n      if (!zh || !en || toks.some(t => !facts.includes(t)) || tokSet(zh) !== tokSet(en) || /[；;]/.test(zh)) return null;","why":"Code can check that both languages name the same teams and players and that zh is not a ；-joined list."}],"examples":[{"name":"Q3 lead for good after an early run that didn't hold","input":"{\"facts\":\"NBA (basketball)\\nTeams: {t:2} = home (Boston Celtics); {"verdict":"The feature's structure is sound: code picks the facts, the model picks the tables and writes one line, and clean() checks the numbers and labels. On the real examples, though, Haiku states things the facts contradict (\"這是本月新開始記的\", \"其中10月支出最高\"), hedges where it should answer, lists rows the table already shows, marks rows its line never names, and runs past 40字. It should not ship until the was‑0, month‑range, card‑sum and mark rules are tightened.","findings":[{"severity":"high","what":"The \"(was 0)\" rule pushes the model into false claims. It says food is newly recorded this month and also calls it \"more\", but October's full-month table shows 7423 for 餐飲. The line also misses the useful extra, which is last month's figure for the same row.","evidence":"Ex2: \"比上個月同期多出來，上個月同期是0，所以這是本月新開始記的。\" The facts have [cat1] 餐飲 7423 and [cat2] 餐飲 6060. The prompt says only: \"call it new, not \\\"more\\\"\".","fix":"Redefine (was 0) as \"nothing recorded in that same stretch last month (上個月同期沒記)\". Forbid \"more\", \"多出來\" and \"first time / 新開始\", and point the model to cat1/cat2 for the row's real history."},{"severity":"high","what":"When every vs row is (was 0), the same-period comparison is empty. The model restates the table instead of saying so, and misses the one real insight in the facts.","evidence":"Ex3: \"購物 3233 最多，上個月同期沒有紀錄，算新增；其他各類也都是新增。\" It walks down the rows and runs about 42字. Meanwhile [cat0] 數位 1940 is already above [cat1] 數位 545 for all of October.","fix":"Tell the model what to do when all vs rows are (was 0). Say the same-period comparison is empty, then name a cat0 row that already tops the same row for all of last month in cat1, quoting both figures and no difference."},{"severity":"high","what":"The model calls a month the highest of the whole recorded period, but the months table covers only Sep–Nov while the book starts 2026-07-08.","evidence":"Ex5: \"只有記錄期間的月份；其中10月支出最高，共32103元。\" [months] lists only 11月, 10月 and 9月; Book starts: 2026-07-08.","fix":"Require the line to name the table's range (e.g. 9到11月裡) and forbid \"記錄期間 / 整本 / 今年\" superlatives. A period before Book starts should be answered as \"帳本從那天才開始\"."},{"severity":"medium","what":"The card-total answer hedges with boilerplate and repeats a figure, instead of leading with the main card and marking the rest. The deeper problem is that this sum is code's job, not something the model should be forbidden to do.","evidence":"Ex1: \"…另有國泰CUBE Apple Pay 260元，無法合計總數。\"","fix":"In the prompt, ban \"can't add\" wording and say exactly which rows count as cards. In the app, have the facts builder add a card-total row (e.g. [card0] 信用卡合計 4783) so the model can quote it."},{"severity":"medium","what":"The model marks rows its line doesn't mention, lists extra rows, and goes over 40字.","evidence":"Ex0 marks \"國泰CUBE •8812\" though the line never names it. The line \"…就是房租；現金用了 11 次，共 1216。\" is about 47字 and walks down to a second row.","fix":"Only mark rows the line names. Allow at most two rows in the line, and tell the model to cut the extra (never the number) when over 40字."},{"severity":"medium","what":"The vs data itself looks wrong and is feeding the false \"new\" claims.","evidence":"October totals 32103 across 38 cash, 21 card and 30 悠遊卡 payments, yet every category except 居住 shows (was 0) for 10/1–10/10.","fix":"Check the vs window in the facts builder (date compare and string-vs-date bugs) against a book with entries in early October. Leave out a vs row when last month's same stretch has no entries at all."},{"severity":"low","what":"The budget answer only repeats the figure printed on the budget table and adds nothing the reader can't already see.","evidence":"Ex4: \"這個月預算還剩 4121 元。\" The facts hold an obvious extra: 11/8 房租 8000 makes up most of 已花 15879.","fix":"Tell the model that a bare number isn't enough when the facts hold one useful extra, and name the budget case as an example."},{"severity":"low","what":"The prompt doesn't ask for full-width punctuation, which the house rules require for Chinese.","evidence":"The prompt says \"Traditional Chinese (台灣用語)\" only.","fix":"Add 全形標點 to the language instruction."}],"edits":[{"old":"A row \"X (was 0)\" means nothing was recorded for X then: call it new, not \"more\".","new":"A row \"X (was 0)\" means nothing was recorded for X in that same stretch last month (the dates in the table's title): say 上個月同期沒記; never say \"more\", 多出來, 新開始 or first time, because other tables (cat1, cat2) may show X before. If every vs row says (was 0), the same-stretch comparison is empty: say so, and if a cat0 row is already above the same row for all of last month in cat1, name that one with both figures (no difference).","why":"Stops the false \"本月新開始記\" and \"多出來\" claims (Ex2) and gives Ex3 a real insight instead of a row list."},{"old":"The tables cover only the months they name; never call one the most of the whole book.","new":"The tables cover only the months they name, and the book may start earlier (Book starts): never call one the most of the whole book, the year or 記錄期間; say the range instead (e.g. 9到11月裡). A period before Book starts has no entries: say the book starts on that date.","why":"Ex5 called 10月 the highest of the whole recorded period from a Sep–Nov table."},{"old":"don’t add: name the biggest part, say the others are marked, and mark them; count only rows whose name shows they are cards.","new":"don’t add, and don’t say you can’t (no 無法合計): give the biggest part with its number, then say the others are marked (e.g. 其他卡已標出) and mark them; count only rows whose name shows they are cards (•1234, a card name like CUBE, or that card’s Apple Pay); bank accounts (Richart), LINE Pay, cash and 悠遊卡 are not cards.","why":"Removes the hedging boilerplate in Ex1 and makes the card test explicit for cheap models."},{"old":"mark: 1 to 3 rows your line is about, from the tables in show,","new":"mark: 1 to 3 rows your line names (never a row it doesn't name, except the other parts in the sum case above), from the tables in show,","why":"Ex0 highlighted 國泰CUBE •8812, which its line never mentions."},{"old":"Do not walk down the rows, repeat the month total, or restate all the budget figures: the tables under your line already show them.","new":"Do not walk down the rows (name at most two), repeat the month total, or restate all the budget figures: the tables under your line already show them. A bare number is not enough when the facts hold one useful extra (for the budget: the single big entry behind 已花, or this week against last). zh over 40 字 (digits count) is too long: cut the extra, never the number.","why":"Ex0, Ex2 and Ex3 ran past 40字 or listed rows, and Ex4 only repeated the figure on the budget card."},{"old":"'Traditional Chinese (台灣用語)'","new":"'Traditional Chinese (台灣用語, 全形標點)'","why":"The house rules require full-width punctuation, and the prompt never asks for it."}],"examples":[{"name":"was-0 row with earlier history","input":"{\"question\":\"這個月娛樂比上個月多嗎？\",\"facts\":\"Today: 2026-11-10. Amounts are NT$.\\nBook starts: 2026-03-02\\n[cat0] 11月（到今天）花在哪: 餐飲 2310; 娛樂 900; 交通 640\\n[cat1] 10月花在哪: 餐飲 7423; 交通 2605; 娛樂 1361\\n[vs] 比上個月同期（到 10/10）: 娛樂 900 (was 0); 餐飲 2310 (was 1980)\\n[place0] 11月（到今天）常去的地方: 威秀 600 (2 times); 路易莎 227 (3 times)\"}","expect":"Must give 900 and say the same stretch last month had nothing recorded (上個月同期沒記). {"verdict":"Clear, well-known places (合歡山, 日月潭) and gibberish are handled correctly and cheaply. But the 'never guess / don't estimate' wording makes the cheap model refuse real, unique places, and clean() then throws away its single option, so a real school ends as a dead end; names also come out as long official titles that don't fit a chip.","findings":[{"severity":"high","what":"A unique, real place comes back as \"not found\". The model returns a single option instead of answering. clean() keeps options only when there are more than 1, so the user gets nothing: no forecast and no chip to tap.","evidence":"Example 2 (竹北高中, only one exists): {\"name\":\"\",\"county\":\"\",\"lat\":0,\"lon\":0,\"options\":[\"新竹縣立竹北高級中學（新竹縣）\"]}; clean(): options: options.length > 1 ? options : []","fix":"Tell the model that a name fitting only one place is not ambiguous and must be answered directly, and that it must never return exactly 1 option. In clean(), keep a lone option as a confirm chip instead of dropping it."},{"severity":"medium","what":"The certainty bar is far stricter than weather needs. Forecasts are the same within a few km, yet 'if you are not sure where it is, do not estimate coordinates' plus 'Never guess.' pushes Haiku/Luna to bail on schools, villages, trailheads and small sights whose township they do know.","evidence":"Prompt: \"Only a real place whose location you actually know; if you are not sure where it is, do not estimate coordinates.\" … \"Never guess.\" The model knew 竹北高中 is in 新竹縣 but still gave no coordinates.","fix":"State that township-level accuracy is enough. If the model knows the township or district, it should answer with that main town's coordinates. {"verdict":"Results filings and guarantees mostly come out right, but two of the six answers mislead a student. The loan answer calls an expired cash pool being re-set 全新放款風險, and the 澄清 answer says the company did not respond and then gives advice. The prompt also treats 累積盈虧 below zero as 'losing money now', has no guidance for profitable results, yields a textbook dividend line with no filing-specific detail, and lets jargon (毛損、本業、業外、關係企業) through to students.","findings":[{"severity":"high","what":"The loan answer contradicts its own reason row. The prompt's renewal rule only covers 'duplicates existing lines', so the model read 原餘額 0 as new risk.","evidence":"Ex 3 row 8: 「資金池業務到期，重新訂定資金貸與限額」; answer: 「原無餘額，此次等於全新放款風險。」","fix":"Make the reason row outrank the balance rows. Expired, re-set, renewed or duplicated facilities are an old arrangement continuing, even when the old balance is 0."},{"severity":"high","what":"The 澄清 answer tells students the company did not respond, but the filing is itself the company's response. It also ends with advice and partly paraphrases row 3, which is drawn right under it. It misses the real insight: 外界預期 is outsiders' estimate, not the company's number.","evidence":"Ex 4: 「公告內容未見公司回應，持股者應以正式財報為準。」 show [3] repeats the report the line paraphrases.","fix":"In the 澄清 rule: never say the company did not respond and never say what to rely on; say whose number it is. On the code side, check that the digest keeps the company's 說明 row when the filing has one."},{"severity":"high","what":"The prompt equates accumulated deficit with currently losing money, so the model overclaims.","evidence":"Prompt: 「whether that company is losing money (累積盈虧 below zero)」; Ex 2 answer: 「越南子公司仍在虧損」.","fix":"Define 累積盈虧 below zero as past losses exceeding past profits (累積虧損), and ban 仍在虧損 unless a row shows a current-period loss."},{"severity":"medium","what":"The dividend line is the prompt's textbook sentence paraphrased, the same for every dividend filing, so it adds nothing specific. Add 除權."},{"severity":"medium","what":"Jargon reaches students, and one line pads by repeating itself, despite 'no jargon'. The prompt itself feeds the terms without plain equivalents.","evidence":"Ex 0: 「前三季毛損且本業虧損，淨損主要來自本業而非業外，持股者面對的是經營層面的虧損。」 It says the same thing three times. Ex 3: 「關係企業」.","fix":"Give plain substitutes (毛損→賣價比成本低, 本業→主要生意, 業外→主要生意以外的收入, 關係企業→同集團的公司) and ban restating the same point."},{"severity":"medium","what":"The results guidance only describes loss cases. Profitable filings, the common case, get no instruction, which invites filler. The title-vs-rows period mismatch is not surfaced reliably: Ex 0 said 前三季, but Ex 5 dropped it while the card title wrongly says 第2季.","evidence":"Prompt Results clause covers only 毛損/營業利益 below zero; Ex 5 line never mentions that the data is Jan–Sep although the title says Q2.","fix":"Add guidance for profits (main business vs outside income, compared without computing). The reason row outranks the balance rows: a renewal, an expired facility being re-set (到期、續約、重新訂定), or a line that duplicates an existing one is an old arrangement continuing, not brand-new risk, even when the old balance is 0.","why":"Fixes Ex 3's contradiction of its reason row and Ex 2's 仍在虧損 overclaim."},{"old":"澄清: what the report claimed; say what the company answered only if a row says it.","new":"澄清: this filing is itself the company's response to a report.
